description: This class includes the manufacture of brooms, brushes, mops and similar articles.
includes: manufacture of brooms and brushes of all kinds: scrubbing brushes, paint brushes, toothbrushes, nail brushes, shaving brushes
manufacture of hand-operated mechanical floor sweepers
manufacture of brooms and brushes of vegetable or animal materials
excludes: manufacture of electric floor polishers, see 2750
